mentions.name: Elo-based climbing ranking app
mentions.description: A free and open climbing app that uses an Elo-like rating system to rank climbers and determine route difficulty. Anyone can contribute by adding gyms, crags, and creating competition events.
mentions.source_excerpt: https://meet.rank.rocks - a climbing app that uses Elo-like rating system for ranking climbers and determining route difficulty. And it’s totally free & open - anyone can add gyms, crag, create competition events, etc.
